preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership)
Attacker must hold some xenoX tokens to perform a sell transaction

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setSellLiquidityFeePercent() and setSelldevFeePercent() to set extremely high fees (e.g., 99% each). Then perform a sell transaction on PancakeSwap. The high fees will cause most of the transaction value to be distributed as fees to the contract and dev address, which the owner can later withdraw using transferTokens() or receive as BNB through swapAndLiquify mechanism.
